en: A vintage black-and-white postcard view of a European city square framed by multi‑story historic buildings, tree-lined streets, and mountains in the background. The central focus is a large rectangular building facing an open piazza, with other elegant structures and villas climbing the hillside. At the bottom margin of the image, there is printed caption text indicating the location in Trento and naming Piazza Venezia and Via Grazioli.
